# ymfm

Yamaha FM sound cores by Aaron Giles, from https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm at commit
81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a (2026-07-27): the files the YM2612 (OPN2) needs, as
published. BSD 3-Clause (LICENSE). pulseman builds them only with `make FM_CORE=ymfm`, through
`src/fm/ymfm.cpp`.
